title.narrative: Mobilizing local knowledge for biodiversity conservation and sustainable development in Central Asia

description.narrative: Central Asia is home to unique biodiversity, ecosystems and cultural traditions that are increasingly affected by environmental degradation, climate change and unsustainable land use. This activity will support local communities in Central Asia in conserving biodiversity and promoting sustainable development by strengthening the use of scientific evidence and local and indigenous knowledge. It will facilitate capacity building, knowledge exchange and cooperation among scientists, communities and decision makers. Key deliverables will include policy recommendations, training activities, knowledge products and improved approaches for biodiversity conservation and sustainable local development.
